The official YouTube channel of Charlotte-Mecklenburg Animal Care & Control 🐾
We share adoptable pet spotlights, animal recovery stories, community events, and behind-the-scenes looks at life inside the shelter. Your support helps give animals the care and second chances they deserve.
📍 Charlotte, NC
💜 Learn more or get involved: AnimalCareClt.org
